Not waterfront kept. Stored reservation.danecountyparks.com link dead -> reservedane.com.
flags: STATUS: temporarily closed for the 2027 season (WisDOT US Highway 51 reconstruction); 'Anticipated to Reopen for 2028 Season'. The DOT project pages load their text by script and gave no dates.

SEASON: stored 04-20/10-15 'approximate' (derived) left alone - the county's 2027 schedule lists Babcock as CLOSED, so no 2027 dates exist. Other Dane County campgrounds run Apr 30 to Oct 3-24 in 2027.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. The Yahara River outflow channel west of the loop is ~15-20 m wide (creek-width) behind a tree belt and the paved trail; the west-row sites are ~45-60 m from it (county map 150-200 ft). Lake Waubesa itself is beyond the river and marsh. At best creekside view; no site within 50 m over open ground.
GOOGLE: 'Babcock County Park' 4.3 / 380 (county park, shared with the boat launch).
